name: robots/okermorgant__map_simulator
title: map_simulator ROS 2 2-D simulator
intro: map_simulator ROS 2 2-D simulator, adapted from okermorgant/map_simulator. It reads `odom_pose`, `odom_twist`, `read_odometry` and `read_scan`; runs `spawn_robot` and `publish_twist`. `spawn_robot`: call the upstream /simulator/spawn service to create a robot or reset an existing robot's pose. The Spawn response is empty, so the receipt confirms only that the service callback returned; it does not prove creation, URDF arrival, motion or a stopped robot. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
